rows.grounds: sandhi fusion of anāhatam (unstruck sound) and tu (and/indeed); refers to the anāhata locus
sandhi fusion of tatra (there) and eva (indeed); specifies the location
bahuvrīhi compound taḍit-koṭi-sama-prabhā describing radiance; qualifies the unstruck sound/presence

items.question: What is the nature and radiance of the unstruck sound present at that location?
premises: The unstruck sound is present at that very location.
Its radiance is equal to the splendor of crores of lightning flashes.
items.inference: The unstruck sound situated there is characterized by an immeasurably brilliant, lightning-like radiance.
uncertainties: Whether anāhatantu functions primarily as a locative reference or as the direct object qualified by taḍitkoṭisamaprabhām depends on the syntactic continuation beyond this verse.
items.plain_english: And there indeed is the unstruck sound, whose splendor is equal to crores of lightning flashes.
